## Fixes
- **Docker over SSH: "Premature close"** – updating a container (and sometimes other Docker requests) over `ssh://` could fail with *Premature close*. When the remote `docker system dial-stdio` finished, the local ssh process could exit before ArrHub had read the last bytes of the answer, and Node then treated the closed input as a broken connection. The SSH connection now ends only when all output has been read, so long requests like image pulls and container updates complete normally.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.15.2   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.15.1...v1.15.2
